response.sql: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM per_media_type;
